supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: slight extension beyond the outer eye corners visible in 2D profile

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: high contrast observed between the pale, low-intensity muzzle region and the dark-pigmented periocular and cheek zones

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: pronounced vertical thickness of the lower lip with a distinct outward protrusion

other_distinctive_markers: presence of light-colored mucosal tissue or tongue protruding from the center of the labial commissure
